question: What happens after reaching the samana level?
premises: Having reached the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss.
Then one is intent on swallowing.
The mass of knower-known calculation is swallowed.
inference: After reaching the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss and then intends to swallow the mass of knower-known calculation.
uncertainties: mānameyaughakalanāgrāsatatparaḥ is a long compound with uncertain internal grouping.
plain_english: Having reached the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss; then also one is intent on swallowing the mass of knower-known calculation.
